title: Bitcoin ETFs Draw $197M, Ending Eight-Week Outflow Streak
dek: Bitcoin ETFs drew $197 million in net inflows, ending eight consecutive weeks of outflows. Analysts are not yet ready to call it a recovery in institutional demand.
author: Crypto Cronkite
key_fact: Bitcoin ETFs recorded $197 million in net inflows, the first weekly inflow after eight weeks of outflows.
bottom_line: Watch for whether weekly inflows continue or if the streak returns to outflows. A sustained pattern of inflows would suggest institutional demand has stabilized; a return to withdrawals would indicate the week was an outlier.
body: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $197 million in net inflows for the week, according to Cointelegraph's reporting, marking their first weekly net inflow since May. The figure ends eight consecutive weeks of outflows.

The inflow reversal comes after a sustained period of institutional withdrawals from spot Bitcoin ETF products. Cointelegraph reports that analysts caution the $197 million gain is too small to confirm a sustained recovery in institutional demand.

The single week of positive flows does not yet establish a trend. Repeated weekly inflows or a material acceleration in redemptions' reversal would be required to signal a shift in the broader institutional posture toward the products.
